title: Metadata for Foreign Direct Investment Equity Inflow in India
text: Metadata for Foreign Direct Investment Equity Inflow in India Item No. Concept Name Details 1 Contact 1.1 Contact Organisation Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry 1.2 Compiling Agency Reserve Bank of India (RBI) – Data collection DPIIT- Data Dissemination 1.3 Custodian Agency RBI & NIC 1.4 Contact Details a. Name of Organisation owning the processes and output: FDI (Policy, Facilitation and Data) Section b. Name: Dr. Kajal c. Designation: Director d. Postal address: Room No. 129, Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 e. Email address: kajal.08@nic.in f. Contact number: 011-23038918 2 Data Description and Presentation 2.1 Data description FDI Equity Inflow Statistics 2.2 System of Classification FDI equity inflow data is classified as sector/state/country- wise. 2.3 International/National Standards Classification/ Codes, if followed Sector wise classification of FDI Equity inflow is based on the NIC Codes 2008. 2.4 Sector coverage Foreign Direct Investment Equity Inflow 2.5 Concepts and definitions FDI equity inflow includes the foreign direct investment reported through automatic route, Government route and Acquisition of shares. 2.6 Unit of Compilation FDI data is collected by Reserve Bank of India from the entity/ company through their FIRMS portal. 2.7 Population Coverage Not Applicable 2.8 Reference Period From Year 2000 onwards (State wise Data is available from October 2019) 2.9 Duration and Period of Enumeration Not Applicable 2.10 Sample Size / Data Size Not Applicable 2.11 Data Confidentiality Not Applicable 3 Institutional Mandate 3.1 Legal acts and other agreements Not Applicable 3.2 Data sharing/Data dissemination Data is available for public use on DPIIT website https://dpiit.gov.in/ . It is disseminated through FDI Annual Newsletter, FDI Quarterly Newsletter and FDI Quarterly Factsheet for use of all stakeholders. -- 1 of 2 -- 3.3 Release calendar Not Applicable 3.4 Frequency of dissemination Quarterly and Annually 3.5 Data access https://www.dpiit.gov.in/documents/publications 4 Quality Management 4.1 Documentation on methodology Not applicable 4.2 Quality documentation Not applicable 4.3 Quality assurance Validation/ Consistency Checks are applied and Scrutiny done before publishing the data. 5 Accuracy and Reliability 5.1 Sampling error Not Applicable 5.2 Measures of Reliability Not Applicable 6 Timeliness 6.1 Timeliness The quarterly data is published on receipt of remittances from RBI. 7 Coherence and Comparability 7.1 Comparability – over time The time series data is maintained for comparability over time. 7.2 Coherence Not Applicable 8 Data Processing 8.1 Source data type The primary source of FDI data is RBI. 8.2 Frequency of data collection Information on FDI is filed by the entities on RBI’s FIRMS Portal. 8.3 Mode and method of data collection FDI data is collected by RBI from the entity/ company through their FIRMS portal. 8.4 Data validation Validation for publication is done by DPIIT through NIC and data at grass root level is validated by RBI. 8.5 Data compilation The factsheet and newsletter published by DPIIT is based on the data received from RBI. 8.6 Data identifier(s) Not Applicable 9 Metadata Update 9.1 Metadata last posted December 2025 9.2 Metadata last update December 2025 -- 2 of 2 --
